item.title: SSL-Vision
item.author: Yash Thube
item.description: Implementation of four self-supervised learning (SSL) algorithms; SimCLR, MoCo-v2, BYOL, and DINO on the CIFAR-10 dataset using a ResNet-18 backbone. All scripts are designed to run on Google Colab Free Tier (single GPU, ~12 GB RAM) with CIFAR-10.
